title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
code: library(gsm.timez) library(dplyr)

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: ’ll use sample clinical trial data clindata package demonstrate functions. key datasets : - rawplus_dm: Subject demographics site assignments - rawplus_ae: Adverse event records dates - rawplus_visdt: Visit date records Let’s preview dataset:
code: # Load subject data dfSubjects <- clindata::rawplus_dm  # Load adverse events (numerator) dfNumerator <- clindata::rawplus_ae  # Load visit dates (denominator) - convert to Date type dfDenominator <- clindata::rawplus_visdt %>%   dplyr::mutate(visit_dt = as.Date(visit_dt, "%Y-%m-%d")) # Subjects: key columns are subjid (subject ID) and siteid (site/group) knitr::kable(head(dfSubjects[, c("subjid", "siteid", "studyid")], 5)) # Numerator (AEs): key columns are subjid and aest_dt (AE start date) knitr::kable(head(dfNumerator[, c("subjid", "aest_dt")], 5)) # Denominator (Visits): key columns are subjid and visit_dt (visit date) knitr::kable(head(dfDenominator[, c("subjid", "visit_dt")], 5))

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: Timeline() function generates site-level timeline cumulative numerator events sequential months.

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: dfSubjects: Data frame subject IDs grouping variables dfNumerator: Data frame event records (numerator) dfDenominator: Data frame time point records (denominator) strGroupCol: Column name grouping (e.g., “siteid”) strSubjectCol: Column name subject ID strNumeratorDateCol: Date column numerator data strDenominatorDateCol: Date column denominator data

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
code: dfTimeline <- gsm.timez::Timeline(   dfSubjects            = dfSubjects,   dfNumerator           = dfNumerator,   dfDenominator         = dfDenominator,   strGroupCol           = "siteid",   strSubjectCol         = "subjid",   strNumeratorDateCol   = "aest_dt",   strDenominatorDateCol = "visit_dt" )  knitr::kable(head(dfTimeline))

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: Timeline output contains one row per site-month combination. Column names follow GSM standard PascalCase conventions: GroupID: Group identifier (e.g., site ID) GroupLevel: Name grouping column used Numerator: Cumulative count numerator events (e.g., AEs) site Denominator: Cumulative count visits site DenominatorMonth: calendar month (Date, truncated first month) NMonth: Sequential month index site (1, 2, 3, …). site’s “study month” - first month data 1, second 2, etc.

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: TimeZScore() function takes output Timeline() calculates cumulative z-scores row using expanding window indexed month. z-score formula : z=Metric−mean(Metrics)sd(Metrics)z = \frac{Metric - mean(Metrics)}{sd(Metrics)} Metrics includes Metric values groups NMonth <= current_NMonth. means: month 1: z-scores calculated using Metrics month 1 month 2: z-scores calculated using Metrics months 1 2 … fewer 2 Metrics exist cumulative window, Score 0.

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: function designed work seamlessly Timeline() output using pipe operator:
code: dfTimeZScore <- gsm.timez::TimeZScore(dfTimeline)  knitr::kable(head(dfTimeZScore))

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: TimeZScore output returns input data frame two additional columns: Metric: ratio Numerator Denominator (Numerator/Denominator) Score: z-score calculated using cumulative expanding window

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: Flag() function adds Flag column identifying statistical outliers based z-score thresholds:
code: dfFlagged <- gsm.timez::Flag(dfTimeZScore) #> ℹ Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 2.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: -2.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 1.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: -1.Sorted dfFlagged using custom Flag order: 0.  knitr::kable(head(dfFlagged))

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: Visualize() function creates line plot showing site’s metric time, dots colored flag value:
code: gsm.timez::Visualize(dfFlagged)

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: VisualizeBoxplot() function creates boxplot showing distribution Metric values month, individual points colored flag value. Points rendered behind boxplots reduced opacity (alpha=0.4):
code: # Show only first 10 months for clarity gsm.timez::VisualizeBoxplot(dfFlagged, nMonths = 1:10)

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: strGroupCol parameter allows analyze data different levels. example, group country instead site:
code: # Group by country instead of site dfTimelineByCountry <- gsm.timez::Timeline(   dfSubjects = dfSubjects,   dfNumerator = dfNumerator,   dfDenominator = dfDenominator,   strGroupCol = "country",   strSubjectCol = "subjid",   strNumeratorDateCol = "aest_dt",   strDenominatorDateCol = "visit_dt" )

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: gsm.timez can used GSM YAML workflow system. Workflow files located inst/workflow/2_metrics/:
code: library(gsm.core) library(gsm.mapping)  # Step 1: Load raw data lRaw <- list(   Raw_SUBJ = clindata::rawplus_dm,   Raw_AE = clindata::rawplus_ae,   Raw_VISIT = clindata::rawplus_visdt )  # Step 2: Run mapping workflows mapping_wf <- MakeWorkflowList(   strPath = system.file("workflow/1_mappings", package = "gsm.mapping") ) spec <- CombineSpecs(mapping_wf) lIngest <- Ingest(lRaw, spec) lMapped <- RunWorkflows(mapping_wf, lIngest)  # Step 3: Run gsm.timez metric workflows metrics_wf <- MakeWorkflowList(   strPath = system.file("workflow/2_metrics", package = "gsm.timez") ) lResults <- RunWorkflows(metrics_wf, lMapped)

title: Detailed Usage and Advanced Examples
text: working data doesn’t follow clindata structure, ensure data frames contain required columns: dfSubjects must contain: - subject ID column (specified strSubjectCol) - grouping column (specified strGroupCol) dfNumerator must contain: - subject ID column (strSubjectCol) - date column (specified strNumeratorDateCol) dfDenominator must contain: - subject ID column (strSubjectCol) - date column (specified strDenominatorDateCol)
code: # Example with custom column names my_subjects <- data.frame(   patient_id = c("P001", "P002", "P003"),   site = c("Site_A", "Site_A", "Site_B") )  my_events <- data.frame(   patient_id = c("P001", "P001", "P002"),   event_date = as.Date(c("2024-01-15", "2024-02-20", "2024-01-10")) )  my_visits <- data.frame(   patient_id = c("P001", "P002", "P003"),   visit_date = as.Date(c("2024-01-01", "2024-01-05", "2024-01-08")) )  # Use custom column names dfTimeline <- gsm.timez::Timeline(   dfSubjects            = my_subjects,   dfNumerator           = my_events,   dfDenominator         = my_visits,   strGroupCol           = "site",   strSubjectCol         = "patient_id",   strNumeratorDateCol   = "event_date",   strDenominatorDateCol = "visit_date" )

title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
text: gsm.timez package provides functions generating cumulative event timelines calculating z-scores clinical trial monitoring. part IMPALA Consortium’s GSM (Good Statistical Monitoring) framework. package includes five main functions: Timeline(): Generates site-level timeline cumulative numerator events (e.g., adverse events) sequential months. TimeZScore(): Calculates z-scores group (e.g., site) based rate events, enabling identification sites unusual event patterns. Flag(): Adds flag columns analyzed data identifying possible statistical outliers based threshold comparisons. alias gsm.core::Flag(). Visualize(): Creates line plot showing site metrics time dots colored flag value highlight outliers. VisualizeBoxplot(): Creates boxplots showing distribution Metric values month, individual points colored flag value.

title: Flag — Flag
text: Alias gsm.core::Flag(). Adds Flag column analyzed data identifying possible statistical outliers based threshold comparisons.

title: Flag — Flag
code: Flag(   dfAnalyzed,   strColumn = "Score",   vThreshold = c(-3, -2, 2, 3),   vFlag = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2),   vFlagOrder = c(2, -2, 1, -1, 0),   vRiskScoreWeight = NULL,   nAccrualThreshold = NULL,   strAccrualMetric = NULL )

title: Flag — Flag
text: dfAnalyzed data.frame flags added. strColumn character Name column use thresholding. Default: "Score" vThreshold numeric Vector numeric values representing threshold values. Default c(-3,-2,2,3) typical z-scores. vFlag numeric Vector flag values. must one item Flag thresholds - length(vThreshold)+1 == length(vFlagValues). Default c(-2,-1,0,1,2), typical z-scores. vFlagOrder numeric Vector ordered flag values. Output data.frame sorted based flag column using order provided. NULL (values match vFlag) leave data unsorted. Must identical values vFlag. Default c(2,-2,1,-1,0) puts largest z-score outliers first data set. vRiskScoreWeight numeric Vector weights apply flag value. provided, output data.frame additional column Weight corresponding weight flag. Default: NULL. nAccrualThreshold numeric Specifies minimum value required return score calculate flag. Default: NULL strAccrualMetric character Specifies Metric apply nAccrualThreshold order determine validity flag. Options "Numerator", "Denominator" "Difference". "Difference" specified, threshold based difference Denominator Numerator given Group. Default: NULL.

title: Calculate Cumulative Z-Scores for Timeline Data — TimeZScore
code: library(dplyr) #>  #> Attaching package: ‘dplyr’ #> The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’: #>  #>     filter, lag #> The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’: #>  #>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union dfSubjects <- data.frame(   SubjectID = c(1, 2, 3, 4),   SiteID = c("A", "A", "B", "B") ) dfNumerator <- data.frame(   SubjectID = c(1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 4),   EventDate = as.Date(c(     "2022-01-01", "2022-01-15", "2022-02-01",     "2022-01-10", "2022-01-05", "2022-01-20", "2022-02-01"   )) ) dfDenominator <- data.frame(   SubjectID = c(1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4),   VisitDate = as.Date(c(     "2022-01-01", "2022-01-20", "2022-01-01", "2022-02-01",     "2022-01-01", "2022-01-15", "2022-01-01", "2022-02-01"   )) )  dfTimeline <- Timeline(   dfSubjects = dfSubjects,   dfNumerator = dfNumerator,   dfDenominator = dfDenominator,   strGroupCol = "SiteID",   strSubjectCol = "SubjectID",   strNumeratorDateCol = "EventDate",   strDenominatorDateCol = "VisitDate" )  TimeZScore(dfTimeline) #> # A tibble: 4 × 8 #>   GroupID GroupLevel Numerator Denominator DenominatorMonth NMonth Metric  Score #>   <chr>   <chr>          <int>       <int> <date>            <int>  <dbl>  <dbl> #> 1 A       SiteID             2           3 2022-01-01            1  0.667  0.707 #> 2 A       SiteID             3           4 2022-02-01            2  0.75   0.227 #> 3 B       SiteID             1           3 2022-01-01            1  0.333 -0.707 #> 4 B       SiteID             4           4 2022-02-01            2  1      1.13

what: Generate Site-Level Cumulative Event Timeline — Timeline
title: Generate Site-Level Cumulative Event Timeline — Timeline
text: function generates site-level (group-level) timeline joining numerator events (e.g., adverse events, required reports) corresponding denominator periods (e.g., visits, time points). calculates cumulative metrics aggregated site/group level month.

title: Generate Site-Level Cumulative Event Timeline — Timeline
code: Timeline(   dfSubjects,   dfNumerator,   dfDenominator,   strGroupCol,   strGroupLevel = NULL,   strSubjectCol,   strNumeratorCol = NULL,   strDenominatorCol = NULL,   strNumeratorDateCol,   strDenominatorDateCol )

title: Generate Site-Level Cumulative Event Timeline — Timeline
text: dfSubjects data frame containing unique subject IDs grouping variables. dfNumerator data frame containing event records (numerator). must contain subject ID column date column. dfDenominator data frame containing time point records (denominator, e.g., visits). must contain subject ID column date column. strGroupCol name column dfSubjects used grouping subjects (e.g., "SiteID", "Treatment"). strGroupLevel Optional character string specifying subset level within strGroupCol analyzed. NULL, full column used. strSubjectCol name unique subject ID column dfSubjects. strNumeratorCol name subject ID column dfNumerator. Defaults value strSubjectCol. strDenominatorCol name subject ID column dfDenominator. Defaults value strSubjectCol. strNumeratorDateCol name date column dfNumerator (must class "Date", "POSIXct", "POSIXlt"). strDenominatorDateCol name date column dfDenominator (must class "Date", "POSIXct", "POSIXlt").

title: Generate Site-Level Cumulative Event Timeline — Timeline
text: tibble site-level monthly aggregations containing: GroupID site/group identifier strGroupCol. GroupLevel grouping level name. Numerator Total cumulative numerator events (e.g., AEs) across subjects site month. Denominator Total cumulative visits across subjects site month. DenominatorMonth month (Date, truncated first month). NMonth Sequential month number group (1, 2, 3, ...).

title: Generate Site-Level Cumulative Event Timeline — Timeline
code: library(dplyr)  # Example data dfSubjects <- data.frame(   SubjectID = c(1, 2, 3),   SiteID = c("A", "A", "B") ) dfNumerator <- data.frame(   SubjectID = c(1, 1, 2, 3),   EventDate = as.Date(c("2022-01-01", "2022-01-15", "2022-02-01", "2022-02-15")) ) dfDenominator <- data.frame(   SubjectID = c(1, 1, 2, 2, 3),   VisitDate = as.Date(c("2022-01-01", "2022-01-20", "2022-01-15", "2022-02-01", "2022-02-01")) )  # Generate site-level timeline Timeline(   dfSubjects = dfSubjects,   dfNumerator = dfNumerator,   dfDenominator = dfDenominator,   strGroupCol = "SiteID",   strSubjectCol = "SubjectID",   strNumeratorDateCol = "EventDate",   strDenominatorDateCol = "VisitDate" ) #> # A tibble: 3 × 6 #>   GroupID GroupLevel Numerator Denominator DenominatorMonth NMonth #>   <chr>   <chr>          <int>       <int> <date>            <int> #> 1 A       SiteID             2           3 2022-01-01            1 #> 2 A       SiteID             3           4 2022-02-01            2 #> 3 B       SiteID             0           1 2022-02-01            1
